name: Solana Across Campuses - Bhopal India
description:
## Solana Across Campuses – Bhopal | India

📍 Location: TBA after approval
 🗓 Date: Tuesday, September 16, 2026
⏰ Time: 2:30 PM Onwards
👤 [Organizer: Aniket Sahu](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aniketsahu115) & [The Origin Guild Community](https://x.com/og_guild?utm_source=luma)

About the Event

Join us for Solana Across Campuses – India, [a nationwide student-led initiative powered by College.xyz](https://College.xyz) supported by the Solana Foundation and The Origin Guild Community, a student first Web3 collective empowering builders through workshops, mentorship and hackathon support to bring builders, creators and innovators together to explore the Solana ecosystem.

This Bhopal edition, hosted in Bhopal, is your chance to dive deep into Web3, learn how to get started on Solana, meet like-minded students and experience the decentralized future - all in one day!

If you are a developer, designer, community builder or just curious about crypto, this meetup will help you understand how to build, earn and grow on Solana.

Agenda

• Welcome & Check-in- Meet fellow student
• [Introduction to Solana & College.xyz](https://College.xyz)
  Learn about the Solana ecosystem, why it’s the [fastest-growing blockchain for developers and how College.xyz](https://College.xyz) empowers student builders globally.
• Wallet Setup & On-chain Demo
  Hands-on session to set up your first Solana wallet (Phantom / Backpack) and experience on-chain apps like Jupiter Exchange and Solana Pay.
• Building on Solana – Student Stories & Opportunities
  Discover real student projects built on Solana and how you can participate in hackathons, grants and the Colosseum Cypherpunk Bounty.
• Mini Workshop / Quiz Challenge
  Engage in a fun on-chain quiz and mini challenge to test your Solana knowledge - winners earn some free SOL
• Networking & Open Discussion
  Meet local builders, discuss ideas and explore future collaborations or projects under the Solana student network.
• Closing Remarks & Group Photo
  Wrap up the evening with closing notes and community announcements, followed by group pictures and refreshments.
• The Origin Guild Community Intro - learn about their local initiatives, mentorship opportunities and how to join future workshops events and hackathons

Why You Should Attend

• Earn Free SOL: Complete the onboarding tasks and on-chain quiz to win rewards.
• Win Solana Breakpoint Travel Subsidies: Top student builders of Colosseum hackathon can qualify for travel support to attend Solana Breakpoint 2026.
• Exclusive Learning Access: Early access [to the Solana Developer Curriculum curated by College.xyz](https://College.xyz) and Solana Foundation.
• Free Swags & Merch: Limited-edition Solana goodies for active participants(Yet to Finalize).
• Network with Builders: Connect with like-minded students, mentors and community leaders in the Web3 ecosystem.
• Get Certified: Receive an official participation badge via Luma (NFT-based certification coming soon).
• Exclusive access to The Origin Guild Community mentorship channels and invites to future local build nights and hacktrains

Who Can Attend

• University students (developers, designers and enthusiasts)
• Web2 and Web3 beginners curious about Solana
• Hackathon participants or aspiring builders
• Community organizers & tech club members

No prior blockchain experience needed - just curiosity and excitement to learn something new!

Limited Slots Available
So grab your spot early and be part of India’s biggest Solana student onboarding campaign.

✨ Powered by

[Solana Foundation x College.xyz](https://College.xyz)

Stay Connected

Join The Origin Guild Community to stay updated with announcements, collaborations, and upcoming Solana ecosystem opportunities.

Telegram: https://t.me/tog_guild
[WhatsApp: Join WhatsApp Group](https://chat.whatsapp.com/Ij3DzAbeA3M7bzA7zkhtHx?utm_source=luma)

Stay in the loop for community calls, build sessions and future campus activations powered by The Origin Guild.

[Solana Across Campuses is a nationwide initiative powered by](http://college.xyz/?utm_source=luma)[College.xyz](https://College.xyz) and Solana Foundation, bringing the Solana ecosystem directly to university campuses across the globe. We're inviting students to host their own campus meetup, a chance to bring builders, creators and curious minds together to explore what's happening on Solana.

These events are open to all students, not just blockchain club members. Anyone curious about crypto, from any major, is welcome to attend. Each event is designed to be simple to run and useful for students at every level: attendees will learn how to set up their first wallet, potentially walk away with some SOL, and see live examples of what is available within the Solana ecosystem.

name: Monad Blitz Mumbai V4
description:
## One Day. No Limits. Just Ship.

Monad Blitz is storming into Mumbai for Blitz V4! This isn't your typical multi-day hackathon. It's a high-intensity, one-day IRL build sprint where you'll learn Monad, ship fast, and plug directly into one of the most exciting high-performance blockchain ecosystems today.

Since launching in 2025, Monad Blitz has energized builders from Shenzhen to San Francisco through 50+ Blitz Hacks. Now, the energy continues in Mumbai.

Get ready for an all-action day where you learn, build, vibe, and ship, all at ludicrous speed.

## ⚡ THE VIBE

Mumbai Blitz isn't about fancy zones or over-engineered setups. It's about pure builder energy and a day dedicated to creating, collaborating, and shipping at speed.

🤝 Connect with Mumbai's Sharpest Builders

Meet some of the city's most talented developers. Share ideas, spark new ones, form teams instantly, and build alongside people who move as fast as you do.

💡 Collaborate & Ship Wild Ideas

Come with an idea or discover one on the spot. Blitz is designed for momentum. Prototype fast, get real feedback, iterate quickly, and ship a consumer-ready dApp on Monad by evening.

🍽️ Energise, Build, Repeat

Good food, good conversations, and a lot of code. Expect a full day of vibes, velocity, and execution.

## 🎯 THE STAKES

$1,500 Prize Pool

• 🥇 1st Place: $500
• 🥈 2nd Place: $400
• 🥉 3rd Place: $300
• 🎖️ 4th Place: $200
• 🎗️ 5th Place: $100

Peer-Judged: Your fellow builders choose the winners. Zero Constraints: Build any consumer app on Monad. If it runs, it's fair game.

## THE FLOW

1. Learn: Morning workshops and hands-on mentoring to get you up to speed on Monad.
2. Build: 7 hours of high-speed execution. Form a team or go solo.
3. Ship: Demo your MVP to the crowd.
4. Win: Claim your share of the prize.

## WHY BLITZ?

Monad is built for speed, and Blitz is how we prove it.

We provide the environment, the mentors, and the brain fuel (yes, everything is purple). You bring the code.

Whether you're a seasoned EVM developer or just curious about high-performance blockchains, if you can ship, you belong here.

📅 Event Date: 19 September
📝 Applications close: 17 September

Capacity is limited. Apply early to secure your spot.

## 🧑‍💻 WHO SHOULD APPLY?

Mumbai's best builders:

• Proven Builders: Show off your GitHub, portfolio, or past projects.
• Experimenters & Innovators: Bring that idea you've been itching to test.
• Fast Learners: You thrive in high-tempo environments.
• Community-Minded Devs: Ready to connect and join the Monad ecosystem.

Teams of up to 3 members allowed.

## About Monad

Monad is a high-performance, EVM-compatible Layer 1 blockchain built from the ground up for parallel execution.

With innovations in consensus and execution, Monad can scale to 10,000 TPS, enabling new classes of hyper-responsive, consumer-ready applications.

## About Monad Blitz

Monad Blitz is a global one-day hackathon series designed for speed, experimentation, and real output.

It has traveled from Shenzhen to San Francisco, empowering thousands of developers and producing hundreds of prototypes, all in a single day per city.

If you like working fast, this is where you belong.

## Disclaimer

By attending an event organized by Monad Foundation, you are entering an area where photography, audio and video live-streaming and/or recording may occur.

Your entry and presence at such an event constitutes your consent to be photographed, filmed (including live-streamed), and/or otherwise recorded and to the release, publication, exhibition, or reproduction of any recorded media of your appearance, voice, and name for any purpose in connection with Monad Foundation and its initiatives.

By attending the event, you waive and release any claims related to the use of such media.

name: Team1 India Workshop | Indore
description:
## Welcome to the Team1 India Avalanche Workshop in Indore

## Introduction

Join Team1 India in Indore for a hands-on developer workshop where you'll go from zero to deploying your first smart contract on Avalanche Fuji C-Chain.

This session is designed for developers, engineering students, beginner Solidity builders, hackathon participants, and anyone curious about building on Avalanche.

No previous blockchain experience is required.

During the workshop, you'll:

• Set up a Core or compatible wallet
• Connect to Avalanche Fuji C-Chain
• Claim free testnet AVAX
• Learn the basics of Solidity
• Write and compile a smart contract in Remix
• Deploy it to Avalanche Fuji
• Interact with your contract on-chain
• Verify your deployment on Snowtrace
• Leave with a public proof-of-work link you can share

💻 Bring your laptop
🌐 Reliable Wi-Fi will be available
🎟️ Limited to approximately 45 participants

After the workshop, stick around for food, networking, and conversations with fellow developers and builders from Indore.

## 🗓️ Event Program

5:30 PM — Doors open, registrations & networking

6:00 PM — Welcome & opening by Team1 host
[Laksh Dilliwal](https://x.com/lakshdilliwal)

6:10 PM — Introduction to Team1, Avalanche & the C-Chain ecosystem

6:25 PM — Wallet setup, wallet safety & Avalanche Fuji Testnet

6:40 PM — Claim testnet AVAX & introduction to Avalanche Builder Hub

6:55 PM — Introduction to Remix IDE & Solidity basics

7:10 PM — Build your first NumberStorage smart contract

7:30 PM — Compile & deploy the contract to Avalanche Fuji C-Chain

7:45 PM — Interact with the contract & understand storage vs memory

8:00 PM — Verify deployments and transactions on Snowtrace

8:15 PM — Share proof of work, developer resources & what's next on Avalanche

8:25 PM — Q&A

8:35 PM — Food, networking & builder conversations

9:00 PM — Closing

## 👨‍💻 Who Should Attend?

This workshop is ideal for:

• Developers and engineering students
• Beginner Solidity developers
• Web3 and blockchain builders
• Hackathon participants
• Developers exploring Avalanche
• Anyone who wants their first hands-on smart contract deployment

You do not need prior Solidity or blockchain experience.

Just bring your laptop, browser, and curiosity.

## 🛠️ What You'll Build

During the workshop, you'll build and deploy a simple smart contract that stores a number on-chain and reads it back.

Along the way, you'll learn one of the most important Solidity concepts:

Storage vs Memory

You'll experience the difference between:

• Writing data on-chain and paying gas
• Reading blockchain state for free
• Temporary memory and permanent blockchain storage

By the end of the workshop, your contract will be live on Avalanche Fuji and publicly verifiable through the block explorer.

## 🎯 Workshop Outcomes

Our goal is not just attendance.

We want participants to leave having actually used Avalanche.

Expected outcomes include:

• New developer wallets created
• Developers onboarded to Avalanche Fuji
• Smart contracts successfully deployed
• Public contract and transaction links generated
• Developers introduced to Avalanche Builder Hub, Academy and Docs
• New builders identified for future Team1 workshops and ecosystem opportunities

## 🧩 About Team1

Team1 is a global network of builders, developers, creatives, and community members who grow Avalanche.

With 600+ members operating across 40 countries, Team1 drives the democratization and global adoption of Avalanche by onboarding new users and projects through local meetups, targeted workshops, exclusive side events, engaging content creation, and community-led initiatives.

By bridging online and offline communities, Team1 empowers grassroots innovation and expands the reach of Avalanche into new regions and cultures.

https://x.com/AvaxTeam1

What to bring

💻 Laptop
🔋 Charger
🧠 No prior blockchain experience required

Everything during the workshop runs on Avalanche Fuji Testnet, so no real funds are required.

Come curious. Leave with your first smart contract deployed on Avalanche. 🔺

name: NEAR Builders Cafe: Roast My Repo
description:
Think of the late-night bonding at a YC Hacker House or a top-tier AI research retreat. We are bringing together 15-20serious builders in Mumbai for an afternoon of high-trust networking and collaborative building.

No pitch decks. No VC speed-dating. No awkward small talk. We are engineering an environment where you actually get to know the person next to you by looking at their code, debating architecture, and helping each other get unstuck. If you are building AI agents, Web3 infrastructure, or consumer apps on Confidential AI/ Economy, this is your room.

How We Network

The Problem Pitch:
Come prepared to share what you’re building, the problem you’re facing, and what you’re stuck on right now. Keep it short and concrete, no polished elevator pitches needed.

The Room Helps:
After each pitch, the audience can jump in with ideas, relevant experience, introductions, or potential solutions. If you’ve faced the same problem before, share what worked (or didn’t).

We don’t want forced networking, writing exercises, or people splitting off into groups. The goal is simply to put interesting problems in front of smart people and let the conversation happen naturally.

Dinner/Drinks Post-Session:
After the session, we’ll head somewhere nearby for food and drinks. That’s where you can continue the conversations, meet people one-on-one, and explore ideas that came up during the session.

Who is this for?

• Builders who want to find technical collaborators, not just "connections."
• Engineers, designers, and product hackers actively shipping on NEAR or AI.
• People who prefer deep, 1-on-1 technical debates over loud, crowded rooms.

name: Bitcoin 101 for Developers & Curious Beginners | Andheri, Mumbai
description:
## How does Bitcoin work without a bank or a central server? And what actually happens when you send a bitcoin transaction?

Join Bitshala for a beginner-friendly workshop exploring how Bitcoin works under the hood. We’ll break down the key ideas in simple language, follow a transaction through the network, and guide you through creating and sending one yourself.

You’ll use Bitcoin’s test network, so you can experiment without using real bitcoin. No prior coding or Bitcoin knowledge required.

## AGENDA:

• Keys, addresses, and ownership: What a Bitcoin wallet does, how addresses work, and how you prove you can spend your bitcoin.
• How transactions work: How Bitcoin tracks individual pieces of bitcoin rather than a bank-style account balance, and how those pieces get spent and combined.
• A transaction’s journey: What happens after you hit “send,” how computers on the network check your transaction, and where it waits before being included in a block.
• Blocks and mining: How transactions are grouped into blocks, what miners do, and how the network agrees on a shared transaction history.
• Bitcoin’s incentives and supply: Why miners earn rewards and fees, what a “halving” means, and how Bitcoin’s 21 million supply limit works.
• Hands-on practice: With step-by-step guidance, build, sign, and send a transaction on Bitcoin’s test network.

## WHO'S GUIDING

Led by the Bitshala Contributors. We are a community of Bitcoin developers and educators.

## WHAT TO EXPECT

• Level: Beginner-friendly.
• Format: An interactive workshop with explanations, room for questions, and a guided transaction exercise.
• Bring: A laptop and your curiosity.
• Experience needed: None. You don’t need to know how to code.

## IS THIS FOR YOU?

This workshop is for you if you:

• Have used a Bitcoin wallet and wondered what happens behind the scenes.
• Are a developer looking for a starting point with Bitcoin.
• Are new to Bitcoin and prefer learning by doing.
• Want to understand how a network can work without one company running it.

Leave with a clearer picture of how Bitcoin works, and a test-network transaction you created yourself.

[To connect with Bitcoiners in Mumbai, join the Signal group](https://signal.group/?utm_source=luma#CjQKIKC4IuqhHW1AQIB-44S0Dg4Um2BItqRBM_V3pzSAwRPoEhB7_H-3FcjjemIxbLkFtABe)

## About Bitshala

[Bitshala](https://bitshala.org/) is a Bitcoin-focused education initiative where we help developers, designers, and curious builders learn by doing. We run cohorts, clubs, workshops, a hackerspace, and community programs that make it easier for people to explore, contribute to, and build on Bitcoin. Our focus is on hands-on learning, proof-of-work, and growing alongside a community of people who care about open technology, design, and the future of money.

name: Bitcoin Wallets: Keys, Transactions, and the Mempool | Chandigarh
description:
## When you click "Send," your wallet doesn't transfer money, it broadcasts a cryptographic signature directly to a global, ownerless network.

Join us for a deep dive into the inner workings of Bitcoin wallets! Whether you're a developer, a curious Bitcoiner, or someone wanting to understand what happens under the hood when you click "Send," this meetup is for you.

We will break down how wallets manage your secret keys, how transactions are constructed and signed, and how they navigate the mempool to reach finality on the blockchain.

## AGENDA

• Public vs. Private Keys: How cryptographic key pairs prove ownership.
• Seed Phrases & HD Wallets: How 12 to 24 words can restore all your funds across multiple addresses.
• Key Management Best Practices: Hot wallets vs. Cold storage and multisig setups.
• UTXO Model: How Bitcoin tracks ownership using Unspent Transaction Outputs instead of balance accounts.
• Transaction Anatomy: Inputs, Outputs, ScriptPubKey, and Digital Signatures.
• Fee Estimation & RBF: Understanding mining fees and Replace-By-Fee (RBF) mechanics.
• What is the Mempool?: How nodes receive, validate, and queue unconfirmed transactions.
• Fee Rates & Priority: How miners select transactions based on satoshis per vByte (sat/vB).
• Congestion & Confirmation: What happens during high-traffic periods and how to navigate stuck transactions.

## WHO'S GUIDING

Led by Bitshala educators and open-source builders. Our sessions are led by active community members who build open-source tools, study the Bitcoin protocol, and advocate for transparent, open software.

## WHAT TO EXPECT

• Difficulty: Beginner level. Designed for absolute newcomers.
• Zero Fluff: No sales pitches, no trading talk, and no corporate slides. Just pure peer-to-peer technical literacy.

## IS THIS FOR YOU?

• You are curious about how money and technology intersect.
• You want to understand how Bitcoin works under the hood rather than follow market trends.
• You prefer clear, logical explanations over complex jargon.
• You enjoy asking foundational questions in a welcoming, hands-on environment.

Coding experience not required. Intellectual curiosity about peer-to-peer technology is.

You will leave this session with a clear, grounded understanding of how value travels from a local secret key to permanent block confirmation.

[Bitshala](https://bitshala.org/) is a Bitcoin-focused education initiative where we help developers, designers, and curious builders learn by doing. We run cohorts, clubs, workshops, a hackerspace, and community programs that make it easier for people to explore, contribute to, and build on Bitcoin. Our focus is on hands-on learning, proof-of-work, and growing alongside a community of people who care about open technology, design, and the future of money.

description:
## Bitshala BOSS (Bitcoin Open-Source Software) Summit 2026 | Jaipur

Join us for 6 days of fun, work, collaboration, and deep learning at the frontiers of Bitcoin open-source software design and development.

## What’s happening

Expect a highly collaborative residency with sessions, workshops, demos, open discussions, and hands-on building time.

You’ll get to:

• Learn what’s happening at the frontiers of Bitcoin OSS development and design
• Meet developers and designers working on active Bitcoin projects
• Connect with product builders and educators taking Bitcoin to more people
• Share demos, prototypes, workshops, and project ideas
• Find collaborators for GitHub repos, Figma files, personal projects, or products
• Spend time with fellow builders through games, sports, bonfires, walks, treks, and sightseeing

Whether you’re contributing to open-source software, designing better Bitcoin user experiences, building educational content, or working on a product, BOSS Summit is designed to help you meet the right people and move your work forward.

## Timelines

• Monday, 26 Oct
  • Check-in
  • 16:00 : Welcome & introductions
• Tuesday, 27 Oct – Thursday, 29 Oct (10:00 - 17:00)
  • Sessions, Workshops, Open Slots, Demos, Project discussions and Collaboration time
  • Evenings will include fun games, sports, bonfires, and informal hangouts.
• Friday, 30 Oct – Saturday, 31 Oct
  • Bitmela
• Sunday, 1 Nov
  • Checkout by 11:00 AM

## Who Should Apply

We have limited seats for:

• Bitcoin developers
• Product designers
• UX/UI designers
• Bitcoin educators
• Product builders
• People actively working on Bitcoin projects, tools, content, or education

Seats are sponsored by Bitshala, so please make a strong application to help us understand what you’re working on and how you hope to contribute during the residency.

## Bring Your Work

Have an active GitHub repo, a Figma file, a workshop idea, a product prototype, or a personal project?

Bring it along.

BOSS Summit is a place to share work-in-progress, find collaborators, get feedback, jam on ideas, and build alongside others who care deeply about Bitcoin and open-source software.

## Bringing a Family Member or Friend

If you’re planning to bring a family member or friend, we’ll connect you with the venue provider or Airbnb options.

You can directly pay for their stay and meals with the provider.

## Apply to Get Invited

BOSS Summit has limited invited seats for Bitcoin developers, designers, educators, and builders.

If you’re excited to learn, contribute, build, teach, design, or collaborate around Bitcoin open-source software, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and tell us what you’re building.

For any queries drop a mail to contact@bitshala.org

Dharmshala • Summer 2026

Catch a glimpse of the energy, collaboration, and moments from our last BOSS Summit in Dharmshala — from deep work sessions and demos to bonfires, games, and community bonding.

name: ArbiVerse Mumbai
description:
Arbitrum and Aditi Chopra host ArbiVerse Mumbai on November 2, from 10:30 to 18:30 IST. Registration requires host approval, and the exact venue is shared with registered guests. This is the event previously linked as Arbitrum Summit Mumbai.

The tentative program covers priority gas auctions, fast feeds, zero-knowledge technology, AI-driven development and support for builders. It includes a keynote from Offchain Labs CEO Steven Goldfeder and technical workshops. Bring a laptop to participate in demos or builder activities; general attendance does not require one.
